description:
Pick up where you left off without searching through the video timeline.

VideoTracker keeps your watch progress from multiple video sites in one place. Save video titles, playback positions and viewing timestamps, then open a record to return to the video and resume in supported players.

Features
• Automatic recording: Enable Auto Record in settings to save progress after your chosen viewing threshold. Automatic recording is off by default. The default threshold is 30 seconds; you can choose immediate recording, 10, 30, 60 or 120 seconds.
• Resume watching: Open recent records from the toolbar popup and restore the saved position in supported players.
• Search and filters: Find records by title, platform and viewing date. Delete individual records or multiple records at once.
• Manual saving: Use Ctrl+Shift+V (Command+Shift+V on Mac) to save the current video immediately. If automatic detection fails, try the popup's manual recording and time selection tools. You can change the shortcut in your browser's extension shortcut settings.
• Generic detection: Built-in support for Bilibili, YouTube, iQIYI and Tencent Video, plus detection on other compatible HTML5 video sites without adding them first. You can disable automatic recording per site.
• Chinese and English interfaces: Choose your interface language and use a light, dark or system theme.

Local storage and optional end-to-end encrypted cloud sync
Local recording requires no registration or sign-in. Records are stored in your current browser by default. To sync across devices, sign in and enable cloud sync or use manual sync. Viewing records, site rules and deletion markers are encrypted on your device before upload to the developer-configured Supabase service. Your sync encryption password is not uploaded; a sync data key is remembered locally. A forgotten sync password cannot decrypt old cloud data. Cloud reset lets you upload the current device's local data again with a new password.

Data and privacy
Registration and sign-in involve an authentication service that processes your email, account identifier, authentication credentials and session information. The cloud service stores account metadata, encrypted sync data and key-related information. End-to-end encryption protects the contents of synced records, but does not hide account or connection information normally processed by service providers. Loading remote video thumbnails may send your IP address and the requested image URL to the image provider, even with sync off. VideoTracker does not use advertising trackers or analytics and does not sell user data.

You can turn off automatic recording or sync, delete records and sign out. With sync enabled, deletions propagate on the next successful sync. Signing out preserves local records. Uninstalling clears extension-local storage but does not automatically delete cloud data. Cloud reset preserves local records and does not delete your account. Contact the developer to request cloud data or account deletion. See the full privacy policy for details.

Privacy policy: https://github.com/Ankkaya/video-tracker/blob/master/PRIVACY_POLICY.md

Getting started
1. Install the extension, open settings and enable Auto Record.
2. Play a video on a supported page until the threshold is reached, or use the shortcut to save immediately.
3. Click the VideoTracker toolbar icon and choose a record to resume watching.

Compatibility
Detection and progress restoration depend on the website and player implementation. Live streams, restricted players and some third-party sites may not support automatic detection or playback restoration. Try manual recording when needed.

Source code and feedback: https://github.com/Ankkaya/video-tracker

What's new in 0.0.11
• Fixed manual-save shortcuts for videos in cross-origin iframe players.
• Saves the current page title and URL with playback progress, even when automatic recording is disabled.
